text:
Alex: FYI — digging into cost dashboard ingest: prefetch cache credits are being double-applied when a route does prefetch -> fallback. Seen on /chat-stream and /summarize. cc @Maria @Josh
Maria: Whaaat. repro steps?
Alex: Steps: 1) route triggers prefetch (we emit a cache-credit) 2) request falls back to model B and generates token events. In ingest we currently record both the credit (under route) and the full token cost (also under route) so savings look inflated. Example naive ingest SQL below shows problem.
Alex: ```sql
-- naive ingest: inserts both events separately, no parent link
INSERT INTO cost_events (invocation_id, route, kind, tokens, credit)
SELECT id, route, 'prefetch_credit', 0, prefetch_tokens FROM prefetch_events
UNION ALL
SELECT id, route, 'token', token_count, 0 FROM token_events;
```
Josh: Can we attribute by invocation_id? we only sample 1/100 so sometimes prefetch and final don't join.
Priya: Sampling is the crux. Two options: increase sampling for prefetch-events only, or make attribution deterministic via an invocation header. I prefer adding a stable parent id on the wire (X-Invocation-Id) so joins are deterministic.
Alex: We already surface `x-invocation-id` in hosted API but some older SDKs drop it. Short-term fix: when prefetch writes cache metadata, embed `prefetch_parent` into the cache key metadata so token_events can reference it at read time. Long-term: change ingest API to accept optional `parent_id`.
Maria: From Console UX pov we should expose a 'prefetch credit attribution' toggle in the cost-drilldown: show raw vs parent-attributed views and a split bar (cached vs uncached unit cost per model).
Josh: @cost-bot can you run a quick 7d query that counts invocations where prefetch_credits > token_cost by tenant? e.g. `SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM cost_events WHERE credit > tokens GROUP BY tenant`
cost-bot: Ran query for last 7 days — ~4.1% of invocations show credits > token cost. Top tenants: acme.co, labco. Quick link: https://console.redwood/internal/costs/prefetch-overshoot (internal)
Priya: Proposed rollout checklist: (a) ingest API change to accept parent_id + backfill schema (no historical invoice changes), (b) enforce `x-invocation-id` in middleware (warn on missing), (c) bump prefetch sampling to 1/10 for 48h post-rollout, (d) Console toggle + note explaining attribution model.
Alex: I'll draft the PR and include example ingest API spec. Note: do NOT change historical invoice calculations — only internal dashboards and previews.
Maria: Agree. Add a release-note line flagged internal: "Cost dashboard: prefetch attribution fix (internal)". Also add a consumer-facing blurb for devs explaining why numbers might shift.
Josh: SGTM. small nit: make SQL join resilient to missing parent_id (left join + fallback to existing logic).
Alex: Thanks — will include post-merge smoke test to compare aggregated token totals before/after on a sample window. :raised_hands:
